dialect.detail: NIST CCVS (Cobol Compiler Validation System) test suite, version 4.2 April 1993. Uses placeholder names like XXXXX082/XXXXX083/XXXXX055/XXXXX014 for system-specific values. Tests RECORD IS VARYING IN SIZE sequential files.
evidence: ON-SITE VALIDATION, NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF STD & TECH
RECORD IS VARYING IN SIZE FROM 120 TO 151 CHARACTERS

purpose.domain_detail: NIST CCVS COBOL-85 conformance validation suite - sequential variable-size record file I/O test
purpose.summary: This is a NIST CCVS (COBOL Compiler Validation System) test program that validates sequential mass storage file handling with variable-length records (120 to 151 characters). It builds a file with a specific mix of short and long records (450 total), reads it back, and checks field values. An information section also checks whether short records incorrectly contain the XRECORD-NUMBER field from long records.

notable_features: RECORD IS VARYING IN SIZE FROM 120 TO 151 CHARACTERS
P-prefixed lines for conditional compilation/platform-specific SELECT
C-prefixed lines for conditional LABEL RECORDS clause
FILE-RECORD-INFORMATION-REC skeleton with embedded literal template
REDEFINES with multiple numeric picture clauses
61 PERFORM statements and 60 GOTO statements typical of CCVS harness
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: All 711 lines are padded to exactly 80 characters (avg_line_length=80.0, long_lines_over_72=711), consistent with fixed-format COBOL with sequence numbers in columns 1-6 and program-id tag in columns 73-80 (SQ2234.2). Source was truncated at 16000 chars but the structure is clearly identifiable as NIST CCVS. The 'P' and 'C' prefix in column 7 are CCVS conditional compilation indicators, not standard COBOL comment indicators.
